finding.evidence: No capture workflow run was queued or running. Both workflow schedules remained 7,22,37,52 minutes past each hour, but no run was enqueued for 2026-09-22 21:22, 21:37, 21:52 or 22:07 UTC. Repository and public manifests matched, and Pages had completed successfully.

limitations: The repository proves missed enqueue times but does not expose GitHub's upstream scheduler cause.
